newsitem.title: USA: Corrections Corp has $170 mln credit line.
newsitem.headline: Corrections Corp has $170 mln credit line.

text.p: Corrections Corp of America said on Friday it had entered into a $170 million revolving line of credit with eight financial institutions, headed by First Union Capital Markets Corp.
The company said the three-year facility was originally set for $125 million but was increased as a result of a significant oversubscription.
The new facility replaces the company's previous credit line of $25 million.
Proceeds will be used for working capital and general corporate purposes, Corrections Corp said.
